decisions.reason: As a recently launched home-accessory line that complements the furniture range, this rug is likely to be retained unless early sales are clearly weak.
The hand-knotted wool-silk carpet is probably a niche but image-enhancing premium product, so management would usually give it more time before discontinuing it.
Because the firm launched several similar low-pile carpets at once, this decorative variant is a plausible candidate for range consolidation if demand is not distinct enough.
A corner bench fits the core furniture business well and German manufacturers typically keep such seating products on the market beyond their first year.
This low-pile carpet appears easiest to remove because rugs are peripheral to the core business and there is overlap with other newly launched carpet models.
A swivel shell chair is close to the firm's core competence and is likely to stay while the company builds out its seating assortment.
